run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:49:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by the checkout Deployment being rolled to an unstartable pod. At 07:49:49–07:49:59 the Deployment checkout (revision 2, generation 4) scaled its only replica from ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) to a new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 whose container image is the malformed string "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (literal newline). The kubelet rejects it (InspectFailed: invalid reference format; Pod Failed: Error: InvalidImageName), so pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 stays Pending with container 'checkout' in waiting/InvalidImageName, the Deployment reports Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable, unavailableReplicas=1), and the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses — no ready backend. From the 07:50:42 metric evaluation onward, frontend-proxy ERROR spans on span_name ingress and router frontend egress jump from ~1.1 per 5 minutes (07:31–07:49) to 43, then peak ~227 per 5 minutes, and the frontend-proxy error-span ratio rises from ≤0.07% to 2.09% at 07:51:37 and ~5.9–6.1% from 07:54 onward. The new frontend errors are exclusively on the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), while cart/data operations stayed at 0 errors, and checkout's own span traffic (normal until ~07:49, 1177.9 per 10 minutes) drops to 0 after the replacement. Other services show no comparable error signal.

claims.text: frontend-proxy spans with status STATUS_CODE_ERROR on span_name "ingress" and "router frontend egress" were ~1.1–5.6 per 5 minutes from 07:31:42 to 07:49:42, then rose to 43.3 at 07:50:42, 136.7 at 07:52:42, 224.4 at 07:54:42 and peaked at 226.7 at 07:56:42, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans stayed in the ~3,000–3,900 per 5 minutes range.
The frontend-proxy error-span ratio (ERROR spans / all spans × 100) was 0–0.073% up to 07:49:37, then 1.119% at 07:50:37, 2.087% at 07:51:37, 5.869% at 07:54:37 and 6.117% at 08:02:37.

frontend's ERROR spans are confined to the checkout path: span_name POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carried 211.6 errors per 10 minutes at 07:55:37, 375.1 at 08:00:37 and 173.1 at 08:05:37, while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds stayed at 0.

checkout emitted only STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans, with normal volume up to the rollout — span_name HTTP POST at 1177.9 per 10 minutes at 07:40:37 and 07:50:37, then 596.8 at 07:55:37 and 0 at 08:00:37 and 08:05:37; PlaceOrder, PaymentService/Charge, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, CartService/GetCart and orders publish follow the same drop to 0.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout (revision 2, generation 4, spec.replicas 1) has container image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" in its pod template and status Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, unavailableReplicas=1 and updatedReplicas=1.

The checkout ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 2026-11-17T07:11:44Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) is at replicas 0, while the newer ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (created 2026-11-17T07:49:49Z, image with the embedded newline) is at replicas 1; both are owned by Deployment checkout.

Events in namespace otel-demo record Deployment checkout "Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0" at 07:49:52 and "Scaled up replica set checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1" at 07:49:59, Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq Killing at 07:49:52, and pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 InspectFailed 27 times (last 07:55:13) with "Failed to apply default image tag \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\\n:1.0.0\": couldn't parse image name ...: invalid reference format" plus Failed 12 times (last 07:52:03) "Error: InvalidImageName".

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99) is Pending, container "checkout" is not ready with restartCount 0 and state waiting reason InvalidImageName carrying the invalid-reference-format message, its init container wait-for-kafka terminated Completed with exitCode 0, and conditions Ready=False/ContainersReady=False reason ContainersNotReady.

The otel-demo Endpoints object "checkout" lists the pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 only under notReadyAddresses (port 8080, tcp-service), i.e. no ready backend address is published for the checkout Service.

Per-service ERROR span counts at 08:00:37 (per 10 minutes) were frontend 1520.6, frontend-proxy 758.7, ad ~1.06, recommendation ~1.06, and 0 for accounting, cart, payment and fraud-detection; ad and recommendation held ~1.05 per 10 minutes both before and after the burst.
Of the 21 otel-demo pods, all are Running and ready except checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (Pending, not ready); restart counts are 0 except fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b (1).

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b has lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-17T07:29:37Z, before the alert's error-rate deviation, and its current container is ready with restartCount 1.

The malformed image string in Deployment otel-demo/checkout's pod template is the trigger of the alert chain: the only checkout replica cannot start, so the checkout Service has no ready endpoint, frontend's PlaceOrder calls on POST /api/checkout fail, and frontend-proxy's ingress/router-egress spans turn to STATUS_CODE_ERROR — the error ratio and error counts start rising in the first evaluation after the ReplicaSet swap at 07:49:49–07:49:59.

The alert's reported value 2.0444444444444443 corresponds to the frontend-proxy ERROR-span ratio measured here (~2.087% at 07:51:37); the rule expression itself could not be read, so this mapping is inferred from timing and magnitude only.

frontend-proxy already produced nonzero error spans before the checkout rollout — 3.33 and 5.56 per 5 minutes at 07:38:42–07:40:42 and ~1.11 at 07:48:42–07:49:42, with the ratio at 0.014–0.073% — so a small pre-existing error signal exists that the checkout replacement does not explain.

The fraud-detection OOMKill (07:29:37, exit 137) considered as a cause of this alert is rejected: it happened ~20 minutes before the error-rate deviation, the container restarted and is ready, its error spans stayed at the background level (~1.05 per 10 minutes, 0 at 08:00:37), and payment (its caller path) shows 0 errors while checkout traffic and frontend errors were normal until 07:49.

Correct the checkout container image reference in Deployment otel-demo/checkout so it is a valid image (remove the embedded newline; the last known-good value was ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout), then confirm the new pod reaches Running/ready and that the checkout Endpoints object gains a ready address; also trace what produced the malformed value, since change history is not integrated here.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned nothing (status no_data), so the exact expression, threshold and evaluation window behind "current: 2.0444444444444443" are unverified.
Prometheus samples for frontend-proxy begin at 07:30:37/07:30:42, so no baseline earlier than ~20 minutes before the alert is available and the pre-07:30 error level is unknown.

Jaeger returned no traces for service checkout (07:45:00–07:55:00) or frontend-proxy (07:52:00–08:10:37), and the frontend trace query for 07:20–07:40 exceeded the view limit; post-07:49 span status codes and error messages are therefore unverified, and no parent-child call edge between frontend and checkout could be confirmed from traces in this Run.

fetch_pod_logs returned no lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 (07:45:00–08:10:37) or for checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (07:49:00–08:10:37), so application-side error text is unverified; the checkout container never started (InvalidImageName), which is consistent with its empty log stream.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so which actor or pipeline set the malformed image on Deployment checkout could not be determined.
The mutatingwebhookconfigurations query failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so an image-mutating webhook as an alternative injection mechanism could not be ruled out.

Kubernetes-state metrics kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, kube_pod_owner and kube_pod_container_info returned no series for otel-demo in this Prometheus (get_metric_names for kube_deployment.*|kube_pod_.* returned nothing), so no metrics timeline of available replicas or pod image digests is available.
Events returned by the API server only cover 07:35:45–07:58:02 in this window, so any earlier or later event about the checkout rollout is unknown.
next_steps: Fix the checkout Deployment's container image reference (remove the trailing newline / pin a valid tag) and roll it out, then verify pod readiness and checkout Endpoints.
Correlate the image change with the deployment pipeline or operator that applied Deployment revision 2 at ~07:49:49, using a change-history source outside this Run.

Re-check frontend-proxy error ratio after the fix to confirm the alert clears, and separately examine the low-level background errors (~1 per 5 minutes, including the 07:38–07:43 spike) that predate the rollout.
If checkout unavailability recurs, capture Jaeger traces and pod logs during the incident, since those were not available in the post-07:49 window here.
